headline: ‘There’s No There There’: What the TikTok Deal Achieved
snippet: The agreement for the social media app falls short of President Trump’s promises.

headline: Software Is Smart Enough for SAT, but Still Far From Intelligent
snippet: In a first, an artificial intelligence program answered math questions on the SAT by understanding diagrams and sentences, but scientists say machine thinking is still a long way off.

headline: Jade From China’s West Surpasses Gold in Value
snippet: Jade has brought prosperity to Khotan, a city whose previous bout of affluence occurred a few thousand years ago, at the height of the Silk Road.

headline: Safin, U.S. Open Victor, Loses Cool and Match
snippet: SYDNEY, Australia, Sept. 20 — "Some day he's going to crush me," Fabrice Santoro said. "It's just a matter of time."
